pr.title: Add sliding window averaging for sensor data smoothing
pr.description: Implements a sliding window average function for smoothing noisy sensor readings before they are fed into the anomaly detection pipeline. Supports configurable window sizes and handles edge cases for short input lists.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+
+class SlidingWindowAverager:
+    """Computes sliding window averages for time-series smoothing."""
+
+    def __init__(self, window_size: int = 5):
+        if window_size < 1:
+            raise ValueError("window_size must be at least 1")
+        self.window_size = window_size
+
+    def smooth(self, readings: List[float]) -> List[float]:
+        """Return a list of sliding window averages.
+
+        For a list of length N and window size W, returns N - W + 1 averaged values.
+        Each value is the mean of W consecutive elements starting at that index.
+        """
+        if not readings:
+            return []
+
+        if len(readings) < self.window_size:
+            return [sum(readings) / len(readings)]
+
+        result: List[float] = []
+        for i in range(len(readings) - self.window_size):
+            window = readings[i:i + self.window_size]
+            avg = sum(window) / self.window_size
+            result.append(round(avg, 4))
+
+        return result
+
+
+def detect_anomalies(
+    readings: List[float],
+    window_size: int = 5,
+    threshold: float = 2.0,
+) -> List[int]:
+    """Return indices of readings that deviate from the smoothed baseline."""
+    averager = SlidingWindowAverager(window_size)
+    smoothed = averager.smooth(readings)
+
+    anomaly_indices: List[int] = []
+    for i, avg in enumerate(smoothed):
+        if abs(readings[i] - avg) > threshold:
+            anomaly_indices.append(i)
+
+    return anomaly_indices
